name: Algebraic Energy Obfuscation
description: Replaced the cut-size condition with a weighted sum of products over all edges (a "load" model). The new equation `total_load == m + sum(capacities)` mathematically simplifies to `E(S,S) == 0` (Independent Set), but requires multi-step algebraic substitution to prove. Models that directly translate the condition into code will write a naive backtracking check and TLE, failing to recognize they should use an optimized Independent Set algorithm.
